dish.n: Corned beef and onion hash with army biscuits
dish.note: Tinned corned beef, potato and onion fried crisp, plain biscuits alongside.
dish.how: Boil 800g diced potatoes for 8 minutes until just tender and drain well. Fry 2 sliced onions in 2 tbsp oil and 30g butter for 10 minutes until golden, add the potatoes and 2 x 300g tins of corned beef broken up with a fork, and press down. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning once, until crusty with a splash of Worcestershire sauce. Serve with fried eggs, mustard, and plain water crackers or hard plain biscuits.

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the onions in the oil and butter until golden.
Add the potatoes and corned beef, press down and cook, turning once, until crusty. Splash in the Worcestershire sauce.
Fry the eggs and serve on top with mustard and the biscuits.

dish.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes the day before to save time

veg.n: Potato, onion and baked bean hash with army biscuits (vegetarian)

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the onions in the oil and butter until golden.
Add the potatoes and cook, turning once, until crusty. Stir through the beans and sauce and heat through.
Fry the eggs and serve on top with mustard and the biscuits.
